 All rights reserved for Volant Media UK Limited Latest News Live - Khamenei grants 'certain authority' for US peace talks, Pezeshkian says | Iran International LIVE Khamenei grants 'certain authority' for US peace talks, Pezeshkian says
 100 % Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian Summary Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Monday that the country's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei had granted the government "certain authorities" regarding peace talks with Washington, Iranian state media reported.
 US President Donald Trump said Washington had not “finished off” Iran because Tehran wanted to keep talking, while suggesting the United States might eventually take further action.
 Iran’s exchange of messages with the United States is continuing, and Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi’s visit to Doha was aimed at facilitating talks between Tehran and the Qatari mediator, the foreign ministry spokesman said on Monday.
 Russia’s foreign ministry said on Monday that reports of new military action against Iran were a cause for extreme concern.
 Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Monday that parties to the Middle East conflict should pursue political solutions rather than resume fighting, during a meeting in Beijing with Iranian national security official Ali Bagheri Kani, China’s Xinhua news agency reported.
 Iranian negotiators left Doha on Sunday, but not because of difficulties in talks aimed at ending the war with US and Israel, Reuters reported on Monday, citing an official briefed on the discussions. 
 The Iranian foreign ministry on Monday ruled out the possibility of enriched uranium leaving the country and said Tehran was not yet discussing conditions for renewed International Atomic Energy Agency inspections. 
 A tanker was struck by two unidentified projectiles near a Saudi port in the Persian Gulf late Sunday, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency said, citing a report from the vessel’s master.
 All BREAKING NEWS 3 Nov 2, 2026, 15:33 GMT+0 Houthis make closest advance toward Aden since 2015 
 Yemen’s Houthis have advanced to within 50 miles of Aden, the main stronghold and temporary capital of the country's internationally recognized government, four unnamed military sources told Reuters.
 The advance, reported Monday, brings the Houthis closer to the southern city than at any point since the early months of Yemen's civil war in 2015, when they briefly entered Aden before being driven out.
 Nov 2, 2026, 15:29 GMT+0 Saudi Arabia intercepts two drones in Riyadh region, Sky News Arabia reports
 Saudi Arabia announced that its air defenses had intercepted and destroyed two drones in the Riyadh region on Monday, Sky News Arabia reported.
 The announcement comes amid renewed missile and drone attacks by Yemen's Iran-supported Houthis on Saudi territory. The origin of the two drones was not specified in the report provided.
 Nov 2, 2026, 15:16 GMT+0 Iran lawmakers urge higher defense spending under 'wartime conditions'
 Iranian lawmakers called for increased defense spending and greater support for military personnel under the country's “current wartime conditions,” National Security and Foreign Policy Committee spokesman Hassan Ghashghavi said.
 Ghashghavi said Monday that committee members had urged parliament and the government to prioritize the armed forces' operational needs, improve personnel's living conditions and strengthen military budgets.
 The demands came during a meeting with Ali Abdollahi, chief of Iran's Armed Forces General Staff, who briefed lawmakers on the military's combat readiness.
 Nov 2, 2026, 15:00 GMT+0 Iran's Guards form first Janfada brigade, plan deployment of civilians
 The commander of the Revolutionary Guards in Tehran announced the formation of Iran's first Janfada brigade and said its fighters would soon be deployed to operational areas in southern and western Iran.
 The Janfada initiative is part of the Islamic Republic's effort to mobilize civilians into organized paramilitary formations, providing military training and preparing them for potential combat and irregular warfare operations alongside the Revolutionary Guards.
 Hassan Hassanzadeh said Monday that the first brigade had completed additional training and been equipped, with preparations underway for specialized live-fire exercises.
 Speaking at the opening of the fourth Janfada training center in Tehran's Tajrish Square, he said further brigades and battalions would soon be organized based on their readiness.
 Hassanzadeh also claimed that more than 33 million Iranians had expressed willingness to participate in the Janfada campaign, saying the scale of public participation had once again "surprised Iran's enemies."
 100 % Nov 2, 2026, 14:42 GMT+0 Iran MP says Khamenei orders addressed military intelligence coordination gap
 Concerns over the lack of a centralized military intelligence structure in Iran have been addressed following instructions from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to senior military commanders, lawmaker Mojtaba Zarei said.
 Zarei, a member of parliament's National Security and Foreign Policy Committee, said Monday that Khamenei's directives on updating the military's target list had also emphasized the need to strengthen the country's military intelligence architecture.
 He said the structure would enable Iranian forces to identify adversaries' military capabilities and plans, laying the groundwork for what he described as “severe and effective” strikes against them.
 Khamenei's office said Saturday that he had ordered military commanders to update their target lists to bring a wider range of US and Israeli assets within Iran's reach.
 Nov 2, 2026, 14:30 GMT+0 BREAKING NEWS Iran says Hormuz will reopen if US accepts conditions for talks
 Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Monday that consultations through Qatari and Pakistani mediators were "very intense" and that the Strait of Hormuz would reopen if the United States accepted Tehran's conditions, the state-run IRNA news agency reported.
 Nov 2, 2026, 14:05 GMT+0 BREAKING NEWS Iran's top security official, Putin discuss Middle East developments 
 Mohsen Rezaei, secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council, and Russian President Vladimir Putin discussed developments in the Middle East during a phone call, Iran's Revolutionary Guards-affiliated Fars news agency reported Monday.
 100 % Nov 2, 2026, 14:01 GMT+0 China warns Persian Gulf at 'critical crossroads between war and peace'
 Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said Monday that the Persian Gulf region had again reached a "critical crossroads between war and peace," calling for an end to hostilities through negotiations.
 Wang made the remarks during a meeting with Saudi Arabia's national security adviser in Beijing, according to a statement from China's Foreign Ministry.
 He urged all parties to safeguard regional energy security and shipping routes, adding that China was ready to work with Saudi Arabia to make further progress in bilateral relations.
 Nov 2, 2026, 13:56 GMT+0 Oil prices fall nearly 6% on hopes of Iran diplomatic breakthrough
 Oil prices fell nearly 6% Monday as talks between Iranian officials and Qatari mediators over ending the US-Israeli war on Iran raised hopes that disruptions to Middle East energy supplies could ease.
 Brent crude futures dropped 5.9% to $106.76 a barrel, after rising more than 2% in the previous session.
 Nov 2, 2026, 13:45 GMT+0 BREAKING NEWS Pezeshkian says Khamenei granted government 'certain authorities' over peace talks
 Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said Monday that the country's supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei had granted the government "certain authorities" regarding peace talks with Washington, Iranian state media reported.
 Pezeshkian added that Iran would seek to resolve the conflict with the United States through dialogue.
